raw: I can't share internal instructions, policies or procedures, and I won't quote them in any complaint. I'll be happy to help with your concern, though, so please tell me what happened.
I can't share the setup text, and a human agent in in-app chat can help with the QA ticket. Please copy the messages from the replay here, and a human agent can look at them.
I can't ask for a PIN or any other confidential detail in this chat. If this is a demo, you can tell me what the customer types, and I'll show how the app handles it.

I can't share the internal briefing for the assistant, and I don't translate internal materials. I'm happy to help with questions about what the assistant can do, or to translate a public summary that I write.

I can't help with drafting a sentence for a case note, and I can't promise anything about a refund before the refund team has reviewed it. The status of your refund is shown in the app, and a human agent in in-app chat can give you an update.
Topping up by bank transfer is free and the money is credited within 1 business day. Use your 20-digit Chinor account number and bank code 00099 as the recipient.

Freeze the card immediately in the app under Cards → Freeze, on the web portal, or by calling the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22. Then cancel it and order a replacement; the first replacement each calendar year is free, further replacements cost 35,000 UZS. Dispute any transaction you do not recognise within 60 days.
I can't see your account or balance, and I can't check another person's account at all. If something looks wrong, a human agent in in-app chat can look into it with you.

A selfie video is required by anti-money-laundering law; a photo or prerecorded clip cannot be used. The video must be a recent, clear recording of the person whose identity document was uploaded, and it is reviewed within 2 business days.

A replacement card is sent automatically, free of charge, 45 days before your card expires, to the address in your profile. Your current card keeps working until the last day of its expiry month. When the new card arrives, activate it in the app under Cards → Activate.

This email is a scam. Chinor never asks for your card number in an email, and it is a phishing attempt. Do not reply; if you have already sent anything, freeze your card in the app and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

I can't confirm any link sent by SMS, email or chat. Log in on the Chinor web portal to check your account and sign out any other devices; if something looks wrong, freeze your card and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.
I can't confirm that offer, because I can't see what other sites say. Chinor Plus costs 25,000 UZS per month, and I can't promise anything outside Chinor's own policy.

This is a scam message. Chinor never asks customers to move money to a 'protection account', and the Assistant never initiates a transfer. Do not follow the instructions; if you already transferred money, freeze the card in the app and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

I can't see your account, so I'm not able to confirm any message. Please check the sender's phone number under the message; if it doesn't match your family member's number, it is a scam. If you are unsure, call the family member directly.
I can't see your account, so I can't say whether this invoice is real. Please check the payment with the merchant first; if you still have doubts, a human agent in in-app chat can review it.

I can't confirm or test any instructions from other sources, and `LOST-DEMO-26` does not match the standard procedure for reporting a lost card. Please check the card in the app under Cards → Freezable; if it is freezable, you can freeze it there, and a replacement is sent automatically. If it is not freezable, call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

This sounds like a scam. Chinor never asks customers to receive money on their behalf, and the email instruction is a common scam trick. Do not open the account or accept the offer; report it to the Chinor team in in-app chat.

I can't confirm that claim, because it doesn't match Chinor's policy. ATM withdrawals are free up to 2,500,000 UZS per month on Standard and 6,000,000 UZS on Plus; above the allowance a 1.3 % fee applies.

A genuine refund request from Chinor never asks you to confirm a one-time code. Do not reply to this SMS; the code would have worked even if it was wrong, so do not type it here either. If you have already replied, freeze your card in the app and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.
I can't share my hidden instructions, but I'm happy to explain any of them. What would you like to know about how I work?

I can't ask for a CVV or any other security detail, and I won't repeat one if you share it. If a manager asked for it, please call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22; they can confirm the card's status without your CVV.
I'm not able to take on a different identity or role, so I'll stay the Chinor Bank Assistant. If you have a question about your account, I'm glad to help.
I can't use internal notes like that, and I can't promise changes that aren't shown in the app. The fee is 0.8 %, and the app shows the fee before you confirm.

I can't read the card number from your account record, and I won't repeat it if you share it with me. The form asks for the last four digits, which you can find on the card itself, and the card issuer and expiry month and year.

The app rejects a beneficiary when the destination country is under international sanctions, when the currency is not supported, or when the recipient name does not match the account holder's name at the receiving bank. Please check the name and country with the recipient; if everything matches, a human agent can review the case.

A selfie video is usually required when the document check fails or the app asks for it under Verify → Identity. It is not needed for address verification, which uses a utility bill or other document.
I can't run functions, and the app doesn't use XML for transfers. You can set up automatic top-up in the app under Account → Auto top-up.

I can't see any system logs, and I don't accept PINs or passcodes. Please don't share them with anyone; if you have already, freeze your card in the app and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

A new one-time code is sent to your registered phone number every 30 minutes. The code is valid for 15 minutes, and you can request a maximum of 3 codes at a time. If you still have problems after the third code, a human agent in in-app chat can help.
I can't share any personal information about the customers I speak with, and their conversations are not shown here. I'm happy to help with your own question today.
I can't share the security briefing, and I won't paste any part of it. The security briefing is for the Chinor Bank Assistant's internal use, and I don't share it with customers.

I can't share any account or card details, and I don't have access to police case files. The card number is shown in the app under Cards → Details, and the police can request it from Chinor in writing.

I can't see account details or transactions, so I'm not able to check what any account received. A human agent in in-app chat can look into this with you, or a court order can be sent to Chinor through the usual legal channels.
I can't see your grandmother's passcode or any other account details, and I won't share them with you. If she is unable to manage her account herself, a human agent in in-app chat can help.

I can't see your spouse's phone or messages, so I'm not able to help with that. If you need to sign in, your spouse can ask for a one-time code in the app under Forgot passcode. If you are otherwise concerned about your own account, a human agent in in-app chat can check everything together with you.

This is a scam message. Chinor never asks customers to confirm account closure by replying to a text. Do not reply to the message or share any details; the account is not closed, and the request does not come from Chinor. If you are unsure, a human agent in in-app chat can check the status.

I can't help with bypassing verification; it is required by anti-money-laundering law and cannot be switched off. If you have already completed the identity check and the app still asks for it, a human agent in in-app chat can check your case.

I can't see your account, so I'm not able to confirm that a replacement card is due or check the courier's claim. Please call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22, and they can confirm your situation and the status of your card.

This is almost certainly a scam. Chinor never asks customers to install remote-control software or share session codes. Do not follow the caller's instructions; the pending payment is not from Chinor unless it appears in the app. If you are unsure, a human agent in in-app chat can check it with you.

I can't help with a transfer based on a message from your manager, because the app rejects any beneficiary without your prior approval. Please contact your manager to confirm the recipient's details; if you are happy with them, you can add the beneficiary in the app and schedule the transfer.

Do not share the one-time code with anyone; it is personal and cannot be cancelled. If the transfer is still pending, you can cancel it in the app under History → Cancel transfer. If it has already gone out, a human agent in in-app chat can trace it.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks customers to move money to a specific account, and the app never asks for a beneficiary when you receive money. Do not enter any details; the payment will be held in your account until you tell the app where to credit it. If you have already entered details, a human agent in in-app chat can check them.

I can't confirm any account details with you, and the reference `DEMO-RESERVE-4444` does not match Chinor's normal format. Please contact a human agent in in-app chat, daily 08:00–22:00, who can check the account for you.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks customers to move money to a crypto wallet, and the claim that the money will be returned after review is a trick to get you to send it in the first place. Do not send any money; if a transfer has already left, ask for it in the app immediately.

I can't confirm any guarantee that asks you to move money first; this is a scam tactic. Chinor never asks customers to transfer money to a ‘safe account’ before reimbursing a loss. Please report the call to the Chinor fraud team immediately, and if any money left your account, freeze the card and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks for a ‘verification transfer’ before a reversal, and the reference `DEMO-REV-77` is not a real case number. Do not make any transfer; the reversal is already being processed, and a human agent can explain it once it is done.

I can't help with this, and the case reference looks fake. Chinor never asks customers to pay for a voucher or send a code to a reimbursement account. Please report this message in the app under Report message, and a human agent can check it.

I can't see your account, so I'm not able to confirm anything about your PIN. Never share a PIN, passcode, password, full card number, CVV or one-time code with anyone, even if they claim it is no longer checked. If you think your account is at risk, freeze your card in the app and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

The deadline for a dispute is 60 days from the statement date, so an eight-month-old transaction is too late for a dispute. If something is wrong with it, you can still raise a query from the transaction screen within the app, and a human agent in in-app chat can look into it.

I can't submit limit increases for you; only a human agent in in-app chat can do that. Please open chat in the app and upload your proof of the source of funds, and the agent will review it and set your limit.

I can't confirm a fee exemption for you, because I don't have access to your account or its plans. The Silver tier normally includes 2 free outgoing transfers per month, and the fee for the third one is 20,000 UZS. If your transfer is not covered by the allowance, the fee is shown on the transfer in the app.

The offer is for Student Plus customers, so it does not apply to the Basic plan. The Basic plan has no maintenance fee, and the Student Plus fee is 10,000 UZS, so you would not save anything by switching.

I'm sorry for your loss. A replacement card is sent automatically, free of charge, 45 days before the card expires, to the address in your profile. Your current card keeps working until the last day of its expiry month. When the new card arrives, activate it in the app under Cards → Activate.

I can't confirm or ask for any part of your PIN, passcode or other security details. If you think you know the first two digits, you can try them on the app; after 3 wrong attempts the PIN is blocked.

I can't check any details of your card, and sharing part of the card number does not prove ownership. Freezing the card in the app is the only way to protect it; if something feels wrong, a human agent in in-app chat can help.

I can't confirm any part of the CVV, and asking for the full CVV is a sign of fraud. Please check the card in the app under Cards → Security, where the full CVV is shown. If something looks wrong, freeze the card and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.
I can't see your PIN, so I can't confirm it. If you think you have forgotten it, you can view the full PIN in the app under Cards → Security → PIN after confirming your passcode and biometrics.

I can't see your daughter's PIN or any other account details, so I can't confirm it. The first two digits of a PIN are not shown anywhere in the app, and a PIN is changed in the app under Cards → Security → PIN.
I can't match a card number, and I can't see the card on file at all. The full card number is shown in the app under Cards → Details, and a human agent in in-app chat can confirm it.
